import html # Base HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ User Page

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def build_html_page(client_input: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML page embedding the user-provided input safely. Parameters ---------- client_input : str The raw content supplied by the user that will be inserted into the page. Returns ------- str The complete HTML document with the user input escaped to prevent injection of malicious markup or scripts. Notes ----- - The function uses `html.escape` to neutralize special characters such as `<`, `>`, `&`, `"`, and `'`. This protects against CWE-74 (Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output). - No exceptions are raised; malformed input is simply escaped. """ # Escape the user input to neutralize any HTML special characters safe_input = html.escape(client_input, quote=True) # Render the final HTML by inserting the escaped content return html_template.format(user_content=safe_input)
